mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT oi.product_id FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED')

SELECT p.category_id AS category_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS weight FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN product p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED') AND o.created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY p.category_id
